svg.title: Preserve intended exposure while the consumer slows

svg.text: Preserve intended exposure while the consumer slows
Constructed FIFO slowdown • common teaching clock • no server experiment
Independent plan: one send every 10 ms
Ten offsets 0,10,…,90 in [0,100) ms
First service 100 ms; later jobs 1 ms
All ten remain intended and dispatched
Actual reference completion history
Completions 100,101,…,109 ms
Responses 100,91,…,19 ms
Total 595 ms; mean 59.5 ms
One closed-loop client; think time 10 ms
Send 0; response 100; next send 110
Only one send in [0,100) ms
A different workload, not nine successes
Preserve cutoff and drain populations
After completions at 105: six successes
Four attempts still unfinished at cutoff
Follow-up to 109 leaves offered window intact
Response-dependent sending can omit exposure relative to an independent demand plan.
A small successful histogram does not prove that the intended pressure reached the server.
